name: GET (WebSocket) /api/voice-agent/calls/:call_id/live - Live transcript of a call
description: WebSocket upgrade streaming one call's transcript as it happens (381767f5-a64c-4c63-9918-9feab02424ec#AC3 — an authorized user receives live turns for a call over WebSocket and an unauthorized user is refused). Credential: ?ticket=<single-use ticket from POST .../live-ticket> (browsers) or an Authorization: Bearer JWT (server-side clients). Authorized viewers: the call's owner (its requester or the agent's acting persona), a persona with a ReBAC edge of kind VOICE_LIVE_REBAC_KIND (default "supervises") to an owner, or an API key holding voice-agent.call.read; another tenant's call reads as 404 and anyone else in the tenant is refused 403. Refusals happen BEFORE the upgrade, as plain HTTP 401 (no/invalid/used ticket or token), 403 or 404, so no socket is ever opened for an unauthorized caller. Once open, the server sends {kind:"snapshot", status, transcript[]} and then {kind:"status"|"turn"|"ended", call_id, turn?, status?, disposition?, emitted_at} as the runtime reports them. The runner cannot hold a WebSocket open, so testCases[0] exercises the refusal (a plain GET to a call the caller cannot see); the authorized stream is proven end-to-end with a WebSocket client.

testCases.name: A call the caller cannot see is refused before any upgrade
The call owner opens the live stream (WebSocket client; bearer or ?ticket=)

errorCases.message: a live ticket or bearer token is required | ticket is invalid, expired or already used | Invalid or expired token
not authorized to watch this call
errorCases.when: same tenant, not an owner or supervisor
unknown call or another tenant's call
